description: an L extruded 1.5 along y — a low block x 0..2, z 0..1 beside a tall one x −1..0, z 0..2, the front cap at y = 0 one L-shaped face — the low block's top front edge filleted at r 0.3, as NIST CTC-03's and FTC-08's sampled edges are: a convex blend running into a step, its end at x = 0 a mixed corner (the tall block's front vertical edge convex, the step's foot concave). The trim on the convex corner edge lies r past the vertex, on its extension down the front cap; the face across, the step's face x = 0, takes the spandrel between the arc and the corner. Arris refuses it BlendTooLarge naming the edge and the convex corner edge; Open CASCADE builds it

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE keeps the consumed corner vertex on the lengthened corner edge, two edges of one line between the same two faces; Arris lengthens the one edge to the trim (ADR-0038)
